description: This file defines core service management classes and interfaces for a plugin or component system within the WPEFramework. It includes service metadata, factory, and registration mechanisms, as well as interface querying and reference counting implementations.

classes.name: IServiceMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing metadata about a service, including name, module, and version info.

classes.name: ServiceAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing registration, creation, and lifecycle of services and libraries.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Template class that turns a service implementation into a reference-counted service object.

classes.name: Sink
classes.description: Template class implementing reference counting for event sinks or notification handlers.

classes.name: ServiceMetadata
classes.description: Template class that registers service metadata and factory, enabling service creation and querying.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create service instances with proper interface extraction.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the service or sink.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for the service or sink.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Method to query supported interfaces by ID, enabling COM-like interface querying.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a service metadata and factory with the ServiceAdministrator.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a service metadata and factory.

methods.name: LoadLibrary
methods.description: Loads a dynamic library by name.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Sets a callback for service lifecycle events.
